description: This file defines the interface for a SocketServer class and a Response struct, providing methods for socket communication, including opening connections, running threads, sending and receiving data, and managing internal state. It appears to be part of a network communication module in a larger project.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: A data structure representing a response with a channel ID and JSON content.

classes.name: SocketServer
classes.description: A class encapsulating socket server operations, including connection management, data transmission, and threading.

methods.name: Response(uint32_t channel, const string& json_str)
methods.description: Constructor initializing Response with channel ID and JSON string.

methods.name: Open(const string& address, int port, const function<void (const Response&)>& reader)
methods.description: Opens a socket connection to the specified address and port, setting a callback for responses.

methods.name: Run()
methods.description: Runs the server, likely in a blocking manner.

methods.description: Sends an invoke message with specified channel ID, token, and JSON payload.

methods.name: SendAttach(uint32_t channel_id, bool attach)
methods.description: Sends an attach or detach command for a channel.

methods.name: SendExit()
methods.description: Sends an exit command to terminate the server.

methods.description: Reads a response into the provided Response object.
